reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring and running recurring model-driven tasks through cron-like schedules and a management web interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的定时任务，让模型按计划在独立会话中执行检查、处理和报告等重复工作。
summaries.en: Adds configurable recurring tasks to DeepSeek Harness so models can perform checks, processing, and reporting in separate sessions on a schedule.

capabilities: Creates and manages recurring scheduled tasks
Starts model-driven task sessions automatically at scheduled times
Allows task execution to inspect files or webpages and perform delegated actions such as scripts or messaging
Provides a web interface for searching, editing, enabling, disabling, running, and deleting tasks
